As a psychology professor, I'd be happy to share a song lyric that has a double meaning, similar to the flower metaphor you mentioned. Here's one from Bob Dylan's "All Along the Watchtower":

"There must be some kind of way out of here,"
Said the joker to the thief,
"There's too much confusion,
I can't get no relief."

This line could be interpreted in many ways, much like psychological concepts that often have multiple layers of meaning. It's a great example of how art, just like psychology, can be a mirror to our lives, reflecting our complexities and ambiguities.
